prompt: Create a highly detailed shoujo anime portrait of a beautiful princess-like young woman in an ornate pastel rose palace. She has long flowing pastel pink hair with airy, precisely drawn side-swept bangs covering part of her forehead, soft loose waves cascading over one shoulder, and a half-up hairstyle decorated with a large pink rose, lace ribbons, pearl chains, and floral ornaments. Her face is delicate and symmetrical with porcelain skin, a small gentle smile, faint blush, long eyelashes, and large sparkling violet-purple eyes with glossy star-like highlights. She wears an elaborate jeweled tiara crown with pink and purple gemstones, matching dangling gemstone earrings, and a lace choker. Her off-shoulder pink lace princess dress is covered in frills, bows, pearls, embroidery, dangling bead chains, and gem accents, revealing elegant shoulders in a romantic bridal-princess pose. Surround her with exactly 4 prominent pink roses: one large rose in her hair near the right side of the image, one rose she holds near the lower center-left, one rose at the lower right foreground, and one rose along the left side foreground, with muted green-gray leaves and extra pale petals around them. The background is a luminous Rococo palace conservatory with tall arched windows, ornate white-and-gold trim, crystal chandeliers on the upper left, soft pink curtains or vertical decorative lines, and dreamy sunlight. Use a square vertical portrait composition, close-up from chest upward, face slightly turned toward the viewer, head near the upper center, hair filling much of the frame. Visual style: ultra-detailed Japanese manga illustration, delicate linework, watercolor-like pastel pink palette, luminous skin, intricate jewelry and lace, romantic fantasy, soft glow, high resolution, no text, no watermark, no extra characters, avoid realism or 3D rendering.

promptZh: 创作一幅细节极其丰富的少女漫风格肖像，描绘一位身处华丽柔粉色玫瑰宫殿中的美丽公主。她拥有 飘逸的长款柔粉色秀发，轻盈且线条精准的斜刘海遮住部分额头，柔软的波浪卷发垂落在单侧肩头，半扎发造型上装饰着一朵硕大的粉色玫瑰、蕾丝丝带、珍珠链条和花卉饰品。她的面容精致对称，肤如凝脂，带着温柔的浅笑，脸颊微红，睫毛纤长，明亮的大眼睛呈现 紫罗兰色，并带有光泽感十足的星形高光。她佩戴着镶嵌粉色和紫色宝石的精致珠宝皇冠，搭配同款吊坠耳环和蕾丝颈圈。她身着露肩款 粉色蕾丝公主裙，裙身上布满褶边、蝴蝶结、珍珠、刺绣、垂坠珠链和宝石装饰，以浪漫的新娘公主姿态展现出优雅的肩部线条。画面中需包含 4 朵显眼的粉色玫瑰：一朵位于画面右侧的发间，一朵位于画面左下方她手中，一朵位于右前方的近景，另一朵位于左前方的近景，周围点缀着柔和的灰绿色叶片和淡雅的花瓣。背景为明亮的洛可可风格宫殿温室，配有高大的拱形窗户、华丽的白金装饰线条、左上方的水晶吊灯、柔和的粉色窗帘或竖向装饰线条，以及梦幻般的阳光。采用方形竖构图，胸部以上的特写镜头，面部微向观众转动，头部位于画面上方中心，秀发占据大部分画幅。视觉风格：超精细日本漫画插画，线条细腻，水彩质感的柔粉色调，通透的肤色，复杂的珠宝与蕾丝细节，浪漫奇幻风，柔光效果，高分辨率，无文字，无水印，无多余角色，避免写实或 3D 渲染。
